name: Álvaro VIII of Kongo
role: King of the Kingdom of Congo

checks.lead: Alvaro VIII (Mvemba a Mpanzu; 1630 – June 1669), of the House of Kinlaza, was king of the Kingdom of Kongo, from 1666 to 1669.
